guarantees.claim: Outside the case, default combinational outputs are: hmac_hash_done=0, hmac_sha_rvalid=0, clr_txcount=0, load_txcount=0, update_round=0, hash_start=0, hash_continue=0, hash_process=0, fifo_wsel_o=0, fifo_wvalid_o=0, clr_fifo_wdata_sel=1, sel_rdata=SelFifo, round_d=Inner, st_d=st_q.

In StIdle: if hmac_en_i && reg_hash_start_i, st_d=StIPad, update_round=1, round_d=Inner, clr_txcount=1, hash_start=1; else if hmac_en_i && reg_hash_continue_i, st_d=StMsg, load_txcount=1, hash_continue=1; else st_d=StIdle.
In StIPad: sel_rdata=SelIPad; if txcnt_eq_blksz, st_d=StMsg, hmac_sha_rvalid=0; else st_d=StIPad, hmac_sha_rvalid=1.

In StMsg: sel_rdata=SelFifo, fifo_wsel_o=(round_q == Outer); if ((Inner && reg_hash_process_flag) || Outer) && txcount >= sha_message_length_o, st_d=StWaitResp, hmac_sha_rvalid=0, hash_process=(round_q==Outer); else if txcnt_eq_blksz && txcount>=sha_message_length_o && reg_hash_stop_q && round_q==Inner, st_d=StWaitResp, hmac_sha_rvalid=0; else st_d=StMsg, hmac_sha_rvalid=fifo_rvalid_i.
In StWaitResp: hmac_sha_rvalid=0; if sha_hash_done_i, then if round_q == Outer, st_d=StDone; else (Inner) if reg_hash_stop_q, st_d=StDone; else st_d=StPushToMsgFifo; else st_d=StWaitResp.

In StPushToMsgFifo: hmac_sha_rvalid=0, fifo_wsel_o=1, fifo_wvalid_o=1, clr_fifo_wdata_sel=0; if fifo_wready_i && ((fifo_wdata_sel_o==4'd7 && digest_size_i==SHA2_256) || (fifo_wdata_sel_o==4'd15 && digest_size_i==SHA2_512) || (fifo_wdata_sel_o==4'd11 && digest_size_i==SHA2_384)), then st_d=StOPad, clr_txcount=1, update_round=1, round_d=Outer, hash_start=1; else st_d=StPushToMsgFifo.
In StOPad: sel_rdata=SelOPad, fifo_wsel_o=1; if txcnt_eq_blksz, st_d=StMsg, hmac_sha_rvalid=0; else st_d=StOPad, hmac_sha_rvalid=1.
In any unspecified state (default case), st_d=StIdle, leaving all other outputs at their default values (G1).

assumptions.claim: st_q is always one of the defined states (StIdle, StIPad, StMsg, StWaitResp, StPushToMsgFifo, StOPad, StDone).
assumptions.risk: If st_q is corrupted to an invalid value, the default case forces st_d=StIdle, but other combinational outputs remain at G1 default values (safe), potentially masking the corruption and causing protocol mismatch.

assumptions.claim: reg_hash_continue_i is asserted only after the IPad pre-processing has fully completed.
assumptions.risk: If asserted prematurely, the state machine skips StIPad, causing inner key padding to be omitted, leading to an incorrect HMAC digest and potential integrity/security failure.

assumptions.claim: txcnt_eq_blksz, txcount, and sha_message_length_o reflect the exact block and message length status.
assumptions.risk: If txcount mismatches the actual data transfer, transitions may occur too early/late, causing truncated or repeated data, corrupting the hash computation.

assumptions.claim: sha_hash_done_i is asserted exactly once per SHA engine completion and not spuriously.
assumptions.risk: Premature assertion could cause transition to StDone before the digest is ready, resulting in an invalid HMAC output.

assumptions.claim: fifo_rvalid_i and fifo_wready_i obey standard FIFO handshake: rvalid indicates valid read data, wready indicates write acceptance.
assumptions.risk: If fifo_rvalid_i is deasserted while the state machine is in StMsg and not at a block boundary, hmac_sha_rvalid will be driven low, stalling the SHA engine and potentially causing a deadlock or timeout.

assumptions.claim: digest_size_i is configured to one of the supported values (SHA2_256, SHA2_512, SHA2_384) and matches the actual digest size used in the SHA engine, and fifo_wdata_sel_o increments correctly to the final word index.
assumptions.risk: If digest_size_i mismatches the SHA engine configuration or the fifo_wdata_sel_o range, the transition condition may never be met, causing the HMAC to hang in StPushToMsgFifo forever.

uncertain_points.claim: The transition from StMsg to StWaitResp requires reg_hash_process_flag only for the Inner round (line 369). Intent and timing of this flag are not specified in the chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: If reg_hash_process_flag is not set after Inner hash is done, the state machine may remain in StMsg waiting for txcount to reach message length, eventually causing a deadlock or incomplete HMAC processing, potentially leaking key state if not properly cleared.

uncertain_points.claim: The condition txcount >= sha_message_length_o in StMsg (line 370) depends on sha_message_length_o being correctly set before the Inner round finishes. The chunk assumes external logic provides this value.
uncertain_points.risk: If sha_message_length_o is updated late or incorrectly, the state machine may prematurely transition to StWaitResp, skipping remaining message data and producing an incorrect digest.

uncertain_points.claim: In StPushToMsgFifo, the transition condition only matches digest sizes SHA2_256, SHA2_512, SHA2_384. No fallback exists if digest_size_i takes another legal value of the SHA engine (e.g., future extensions).
uncertain_points.risk: The state machine would remain permanently in StPushToMsgFifo, hanging the HW. Currently, the design may limit digest sizes, but the risk remains if support is added later without updating this condition.
